name: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd
title: Anupam Rasayan India Ltd - 543275 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Anupam reports record FY26 revenue of INR2,384 crore (+65%) and operating cash flow of INR334 crore, with capex ended and no major capex planned, but the read is dominated by a debt-funded Bliss GVS acquisition and promotional Q&A.

capex.quote: We are not envisaging any major capex in near future as current capacity is enough to take care of the near-term growth.

triggers.label: No major capex; plants commercialised
triggers.quote: all our plants are commercialized. We are not envisaging any major capex in near future

triggers.label: Operating cash flow INR334 crore
triggers.quote: we have achieved operating cash flow of INR334 crores

triggers.label: Standalone growth 20-30% CAGR 3-5 yrs
triggers.quote: a growth of 20% to 25% or 30% growth rate over the next 3 to 5 years on a CAGR basis is something that we should

triggers.label: Bliss GVS acquisition, INR300 crore NCD
triggers.quote: funded through a combination of approximately INR300 crores via non-convertible debentures

guidance.quote: a growth of 20% to 25% or 30% growth rate over the next 3 to 5 years on a CAGR basis
we should be looking at around about 25% as a tax rate going forward
I think INR50 crores to INR75 crores is what you can look at

guidance.metric: Standalone peak revenue on current gross block
guidance.quote: we should be looking at about INR3,500 crores kind of a number from this revenue
we should be able to look at those kind of numbers in the range that even this year's numbers represent

prior_guidance_check.quote: This improvement is in line with our guidance of working capital improvement, and we further expect it to improve in FY27.

red_flags.label: Debt-funded acquisition plus quasi-equity structure
red_flags.quote: balance one will come in as a quasi-equity, which will be non-consolidating non-dilutive, non-participative equity for us

red_flags.label: Working capital debt ~2/3 of INR1,500 crore gross
red_flags.quote: over two-third will be working capital loan out of the INR1,500 crores

red_flags.label: Promoter exit and CEO change
red_flags.quote: The shareholder and the promoter are relinquishing their control and their shareholding.

red_flags.label: Evasive answers on Bliss plans
red_flags.quote: it would be inappropriate for me to make that statement today

evasions.quote: I don't think I should be answering on behalf of Bliss management today
It is a little too early for me to really promise on behalf of a company
give us a little bit more time and then we can come back with you
